yt_title: Day 8 of 10 — The Firecracker Shop | Anaya's Ten Days EP3
short:
Eight days until Papa comes home.

She wanted the big box — the one that goes up like a tree.
Forty rupees. She had forty-two.

Then the shopkeeper said: it's the festival. The price went up.
Sixty.
cta:
There's one box left at the old price… but it's promised to somebody else 🧡
EP4 tomorrow — six o'clock ✦
